name: Cinematic Synth Scores
author: Freek van Gool
description: Cinematic scoring sounds for the Cinematic Synth, in seven sets: Dream Heist (huge braams, slow horns, dream drones and low pulsing ostinati), Dark Hero (rising swells, cello-like ostinati and dark brass), Space Voyage (organ arpeggios, cathedral pads and drifting drones), Desert Epic, Ancient Battle, Quiet Tension and Impacts and Risers. Tunes with a pulse pattern follow the studio clock and play the notes you hold as an ostinato or arpeggio.
